title: Unified EDIM Model Architecture
subtitle: Separate user parameters and scenario data -> unified adapter layer -> Calliope + MRIO runtime -> integrated results
description: Current EDIM architecture view showing separate user-defined parameters and scenario input datasets feeding a unified adapter layer. The adapter routes energy runtime inputs directly to Calliope and MRIO-direct scenario payloads directly to the MRIO runtime. The MRIO runtime receives three explicit input streams: bridge artifacts, adapter-derived MRIO scenario payloads, and general MRIO input datasets. Calliope also feeds integrated results directly for energy-side headline metrics.

audiences: Frontend engineers building the dashboard and interaction model
Backend engineers maintaining scenario packages, orchestration, APIs, and artifacts
Designers refining the dashboard and architecture explanation
Energy modelers maintaining Calliope and future OSeMOSYS adapters
MRIO/development modelers replacing heuristic MRIO-direct logic with exact matrix shocks
Data/GIS teams replacing placeholder datasets and geometry assets

layers.title: Input streams
layers.purpose: User-defined run parameters, scenario source datasets, and static model input datasets enter the model as separate streams.

layers.title: Unified adapter layer
layers.purpose: One adapter layer resolves scenario selections into model-specific runtime inputs for Calliope and MRIO.

layers.title: Energy model and bridge preparation
layers.purpose: Calliope solves the energy model using adapter patches plus static model data; the bridge converts solved energy outputs into MRIO-compatible exchange artifacts.

layers.title: MRIO development runtime
layers.purpose: MRIO runtime consumes bridge artifacts, adapter-derived MRIO scenario inputs, and general MRIO input datasets.

layers.title: Integrated results
layers.purpose: Integrated result artifacts combine direct Calliope outputs, selected MRIO/development totals, provenance, diagnostics, and dashboard contracts.

nodes.title: User-Defined Run Parameters
nodes.subtitle: Data input
body: Energy pathway, MRIO scenario choice, target year, profile, levers
Validation outcome and placeholder diagnostics are recorded, not separate toggle inputs
Persisted into scenario_package.json for audit and rerun traceability

details.purpose: Captures what the user chooses at run time without treating those choices as the scenario source dataset itself.
details.owner: Frontend setup UI + backend run contract
acceptanceCriteria: User choices remain inspectable separately from scenario source data
Request payload maps cleanly into the unified adapter layer

nodes.title: Scenario Input Data
nodes.subtitle: Data input
body: Energy scenario metadata and Calliope override references
Parsed report scenarios with A/Z, E, Y guidance and target-year assumptions
Geography mapping and provenance records used by the adapter

details.purpose: Provides scenario source records as data inputs to the adapter layer rather than routing them through a separate visible scenario-package node.
acceptanceCriteria: Scenario source data stays distinct from user-defined parameters
All report scenarios remain inspectable through the catalog and run artifacts

nodes.title: Calliope Static Model Inputs
nodes.subtitle: Data input
body: model.yaml imports: technology, demand, transmission, and location files
Power-pool topology for CAPP/EAPP/NAPP/SAPP/WAPP
Demand and renewable resource time series used during optimization

details.purpose: Makes explicit that Calliope is fed by static model input files in addition to adapter-provided scenario patches.
outputs: Static model structure used by Calliope
acceptanceCriteria: Static Calliope inputs are documented separately from the adapter layer
Technology and location names stay synchronized with lever, bridge, and map mappings

nodes.title: Unified Scenario Adapter Layer
nodes.subtitle: Parameters + scenario data -> model inputs
body: Single adapter layer resolves user parameters against scenario source data
Outputs Calliope runtime patch / energy input manifest directly to Calliope
Outputs MRIO-direct A/Z, E, Y scenario payload directly to the MRIO runtime

details.purpose: Replaces separate visible energy and MRIO-direct adapter boxes with one responsibility boundary: translate user parameters plus scenario source data into model-specific runtime inputs.
details.qualityPolicy: MRIO-direct numeric rows remain mrio_direct_heuristic_v1 until exact MARIO A/Z/E/Y matrix shock execution replaces them.
acceptanceCriteria: One adapter layer is visible in the architecture diagram
Adapter outputs go directly to Calliope and MRIO runtime models
Scenario package is preserved as an artifact, not shown as a separate data-routing cell

nodes.title: Calliope Energy Model
nodes.subtitle: Energy runtime model
body: Solves the selected Calliope scenario with adapter runtime patch
Consumes static Calliope model inputs in parallel
Produces energy, cost, emissions, reliability, and spatial outputs

details.purpose: Solves energy-system outcomes under the selected scenario and runtime profile.
acceptanceCriteria: Calliope has a direct arrow to integrated results for energy-side metrics
Solved outputs also feed the bridge layer for MRIO exchange artifacts

nodes.title: Calliope-to-MRIO Bridge Layer
nodes.subtitle: Solved energy -> exchange artifacts
body: Maps solved energy CAPEX/OPEX/fuel shocks into MRIO sectors and regions
Creates service-balance and price/tax diagnostics
Bridge channel remains authoritative on overlaps for now

details.purpose: Converts solved Calliope outputs into MRIO-compatible exchange artifacts.
details.qualityPolicy: UNKNOWN regions and fallback exchange paths must remain visible in warnings and coupling diagnostics.

nodes.title: MRIO Input Datasets
nodes.subtitle: General MRIO data input
body: Employment, value-added, development-model, uncertainty, and supplier-sector coefficients
Expert-owned coefficient tables and placeholder inventory
Used by MRIO runtime in addition to bridge and adapter scenario payloads

details.purpose: Represents the general MRIO/development input data required by the runtime, distinct from bridge artifacts and adapter-derived scenario payloads.
outputs: MRIO coefficients and development intensities consumed by the runtime
acceptanceCriteria: MRIO runtime visibly has three input streams: bridge artifacts, adapter MRIO scenario payload, and general MRIO input datasets

nodes.title: MRIO Impact Model / Development Runtime
nodes.subtitle: Three input streams
body: Consumes bridge artifacts, adapter-derived MRIO scenario payload, and general MRIO input datasets
Keeps bridge and MRIO-direct source channels inspectable
Outputs selected_totals, combined diagnostics, overlap warnings, jobs, GVA, and income proxy

details.purpose: Runs the development-impact model using three explicit input streams and keeps channel provenance visible.
inputs: Bridge exchange artifacts from the Calliope-to-MRIO bridge
MRIO-direct scenario payload from unified adapter layer
General MRIO input datasets and coefficients
details.qualityPolicy: Headline development totals currently default to bridge-derived Calliope values on overlap; combined_totals are diagnostic only.

nodes.title: Integrated Results + Dashboard Contract
nodes.subtitle: Output / UI
body: Direct Calliope energy metrics plus selected MRIO/development impacts
Scenario provenance, source-channel comparison, uncertainty, metric resolution, map/chart payloads
Dashboard separates global results from regional/country/subcountry scoped outputs

details.purpose: Synthesises energy and development outputs into decision-ready payloads and the dashboard-facing contract.
outputs: Dashboard overview, energy, development, and method panels
Map filtering contract and source-channel comparison
acceptanceCriteria: Calliope has a direct path to integrated energy metrics
source_channels expose bridge and MRIO-direct side by side
Map filters compatible outputs while global metrics remain separated

details.summary: Run-time choices flow directly into the unified adapter layer.
Scenario source records flow directly into the unified adapter layer.
Unified adapter emits the energy runtime patch and energy input manifest directly to Calliope.
Calliope consumes static model imports in addition to adapter-produced runtime inputs.
Solved energy outputs feed bridge exchange artifact generation.
Investment shocks, operating shocks, service balance, and price/tax artifacts are the bridge input stream to MRIO.
Unified adapter emits report-derived MRIO-direct A/Z, E, Y scenario payloads directly to the MRIO runtime.
General MRIO/development datasets and coefficients feed the MRIO runtime as a third input stream.
Calliope energy outputs feed integrated results directly for energy-side headline metrics, charts, and spatial diagnostics.
MRIO runtime outputs feed integrated results for jobs, GVA, income proxy, source channels, uncertainty, and overlap diagnostics.

annotations.text: User parameters and scenario source data stay separate until the unified adapter layer.
One adapter layer branches directly to Calliope and to the MRIO runtime.
MRIO runtime has three inputs: bridge artifacts, adapter scenario payload, and general MRIO datasets.
Integrated results combine direct Calliope energy metrics with selected MRIO/development outputs.

mapRules: Map legend colors must match rendered layer colors
Parent/region context may be secondary highlight
Only spatially compatible charts respond to geography selection
Global or non-filterable metrics are grouped separately
accessibility: Architecture diagram has an aria-label and status text
Critical warnings must not depend on color alone
Controls in the production dashboard must remain keyboard accessible
Tooltips should supplement, not replace, visible text for critical interpretation

qualityRules: Placeholders block strict runs unless explicitly allowed
Heuristic MRIO-direct caps quality at analyst_review or below
Bridge selected totals are authoritative on overlap for now
futureAdapters: Exact MARIO A/Z/E/Y matrix shock adapter

apiEndpoints.contract: readiness checks for integrated scenario params
integrated results with source_channels and scenario_provenance

placeholderReplacement: Calliope demand and resource time-series source metadata
geographyAlignment: National MRIO applies to all same-country Calliope subnational locations
Regional MRIO applies to mapped Calliope locations
MRIO-only is allowed when no energy geography exists
Subnational-to-subnational mismatch without mapping is blocking
calliopeStaticModelInputs: model.yaml imports power-pool Location_Constraints_*.yaml files for CAPP, EAPP, NAPP, SAPP, and WAPP
model.yaml imports power-pool Transmission_links_*.yaml files for CAPP, EAPP, NAPP, SAPP, and WAPP
Timeseries/Demand_*.csv provides demand profiles and scenario variants, including 2040 AC and 2040 STEPS demand files
Timeseries/Solar_*.csv, Wind_*.csv, Hydro_*.csv, PV_New.csv, CSP_New.csv provide resource availability profiles
Technology/location names must stay synchronized with lever_mappings.csv, scenario_geography_mapping.csv, country_to_pool.csv, and Calliope-to-MARIO bridge mappings

openRisks.description: MRIO-direct heuristic v1 is not exact MARIO matrix shock execution.
openRisks.mitigation: Implement exact A/Z/E/Y matrix shock adapter and retire temporary merge policy.

openRisks.description: Seeded expert datasets are placeholders and not production evidence.
openRisks.mitigation: Replace with expert-calibrated datasets and provenance.

openRisks.description: Spatial filtering can mislead if chart granularity does not match selected geography.
openRisks.mitigation: Expose metric resolution and only filter compatible outputs.

openRisks.description: Current frontend uses browser Babel/CDNs and lacks build-time checks.
openRisks.mitigation: Add Vite/package.json, linting, smoke tests, and pinned dependencies.

originalState.format: Inline JavaScript object embedded directly in architecture.html
strengths: D3 renderer already supported zoom, drag, tooltips, layer bands, and node/edge semantics
Original node layout captured scenario package, separate adapters, energy model, bridge, MRIO-direct, MARIO, and outputs
gapsIdentified: Spec was not valid standalone JSON and could not be versioned or validated separately
Spec lacked ownership, audiences, acceptance criteria, API contracts, artifact contracts, data requirements, risks, and testing requirements
Trust, placeholder, and spatial resolution concepts needed clear supporting requirements without overloading the visible graph.
Frontend dashboard interpretation rules and map filtering rules were not represented as explicit requirements
MRIO-direct heuristic status and bridge-authoritative overlap policy needed stronger labeling
Scenario source datasets and user-defined run parameters needed to be represented as separate input streams rather than a single scenario package box.
Separate energy and MRIO-direct adapter nodes overstated the conceptual split; the visible architecture needed one unified adapter layer.
